key_insight: TEMPLAR is an agentic, template-centric framework that automatically induces and evolves standardized radiology reporting templates from large clinical corpora using anatomy- and diagnosis-aware knowledge graphs.
clinical_relevance: It aims to make radiology reports more structured, consistent, and adaptable across institutions, improving downstream report structuring and diagnostic reasoning.
method: Induction Agent: clusters anatomy-constrained span-triple atoms into canonical clinical slots.
Evolution Agent: assembles slots into a hierarchical template and revises it using consistency checks, external clinical evidence, and downstream feedback.
Clinical Agent: applies the evolved template for report structuring, reconstruction, and diagnosis support.
evidence_signal: Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperformed ASTAR, multiple medical and general LLMs on coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, and held up in cross-dataset transfer tests.
watch_item: Performance is evaluated on benchmark corpora and LLM-rated template quality, so real-world deployment would still need careful site-specific validation and governance.
paper_title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
